class.name: TickObject
class.brief_description: Synchronizes properties of a node through a [TickNetwork].

method.name: _apply_interpolated_state
method.description: Called on peers that interpolate this object, with the interpolated value of each declared property. If not overridden, the properties are set on the root node.

method.name: _approve_authority_request
method.description: With [constant TickNetwork.AUTHORITY_DISTRIBUTED]: called on the owner when [param requester] asks for this object; return [code]false[/code] to refuse. If not overridden, requests are approved. Assignments ([method assign_authority]) can't be refused.

method.name: _collect_input
method.description: Called on the controller, once per tick, to write the input of this tick in [param input]. Not called during rewinds: the stored inputs are used.

method.name: _on_authority_changed
method.description: With [constant TickNetwork.AUTHORITY_DISTRIBUTED]: called on every node when the owner of this object changes ([param new_owner] is 0 when nobody owns it).

method.name: _on_event
method.description: Runs an event sent to this object by [param sender] (see [method send_event]). [param frame] is the frame the event was sent for; on the server, a client event runs at that frame, or at the next one if it already passed.

method.name: _on_relevance_changed
method.description: Client: called when the server starts or stops sending this object's state (see [member TickNetwork.interest_filter]).

method.name: _process_tick
method.description: Advances the object by one tick. [param input] holds the controller's input; it's empty (size 0) when no input is available. Called on the server, on the predicting client and on the peers that simulate the object as a doll, also during rewinds (see [method is_rewinding]).

method.name: _setup_sync
method.description: Called once, before the object is registered in the network. Declare the synchronized properties here with [method declare_var].

method.name: _validate_event
method.description: Called on the server for each event a client sends to this object; return [code]false[/code] to refuse it. If not overridden, [member TickNetwork.trust] decides: untrusted networks only accept events from the [member controller_peer].

method.name: assign_authority
method.description: With [constant TickNetwork.AUTHORITY_DISTRIBUTED]: asks the registry to give this object to [param peer]. An orphan is assigned directly, from its last known state; an owned object is transferred without asking its owner. Used, for example, to adopt orphans (see [signal TickNetwork.authority_orphaned]).

method.name: declare_var
method.description: Declares a property of the root node to synchronize, encoded with [param codec]. Nested properties use the property path syntax, for example [code]"transform:origin"[/code]. Only valid inside [method _setup_sync].

method.name: get_declared_vars
method.description: Returns the names of the declared properties.

method.name: get_net_id
method.description: Returns the network id of this object, or 0 if it isn't synchronized yet.

method.name: get_network
method.description: Returns the [TickNetwork] this object is registered in, or [code]null[/code] (also once that network was freed; the object registers again the next time it enters the tree).

method.name: get_owner_peer
method.description: Returns the node that currently simulates this object: the network's authority with [constant TickNetwork.AUTHORITY_SINGLE], or the current owner with [constant TickNetwork.AUTHORITY_DISTRIBUTED] (0 when nobody owns it).

method.name: get_root_node
method.description: Returns the node whose properties are synchronized.

method.name: get_state_at
method.description: Returns this object's state at [param frame]; see [method TickNetwork.get_state_at].

method.name: is_owner
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this peer simulates the object.

method.name: is_relevant
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this peer gets this object's state; always [code]true[/code] on the server.

method.name: is_rewinding
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the network simulates again past frames. Use it to skip side effects.

method.name: release_authority
method.description: With [constant TickNetwork.AUTHORITY_DISTRIBUTED]: the owner gives this object to [param to_peer], or leaves it orphaned with 0. The object stops being simulated here right away; the new owner continues from its state.

method.name: request_authority
method.description: With [constant TickNetwork.AUTHORITY_DISTRIBUTED]: asks the registry for this object. The owner may refuse ([method _approve_authority_request]); a request that arrives while another transfer of the object is in progress is refused, and so is one the registry didn't answer before moving to another node ([signal TickNetwork.authority_request_denied]). Once transferred, [method _on_authority_changed] is called on every node.

method.name: send_event
method.description: Sends an event to this object on the other side. From a client, it goes to the server, for [param frame] (by default, the frame the client predicts), and the server calls [method _validate_event] then [method _on_event]. From the server, it goes to [param peer], or every client with 0, and runs on arrival or, with [param frame], when the client's simulation reaches that frame. The name of the event takes at most 255 bytes in UTF-8. Events aren't repeated during rewinds.

members.member: Peer whose input drives this object: 1 for the server (NPCs, the host), or a client id. With [constant TickNetwork.AUTHORITY_DISTRIBUTED], the node that owns the object at first. It can't change while the object is registered.
Path to the [TickNetwork]. If empty, the first [TickNetwork] ancestor is used, or else the first one in the scene.
How the peers that don't control this object show it, with [constant TickNetwork.AUTHORITY_SINGLE]. It can't change while the object is registered, and should be the same on every peer.
Path to the node whose properties are synchronized.

constants.constant: The object is interpolated between the authority's snapshots, [member TickNetwork.interpolation_delay] behind the authority. The default.

The object is simulated with its controller's inputs, as a doll: behind the controller by the latency to it plus a small input buffer, and corrected by the authority's snapshots. The controller sends its inputs to every peer it's connected to, so dolls need a mesh ([EnetMeshTransport] or [EnetHostedMeshTransport]); in a star, only the server's objects can be dolls, and the others are interpolated. A doll whose controller stops sending inputs is interpolated again.
